preconditions.description: The size of set S is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s <= 10**6 for s in S) and len(S) == m and S == sorted(S)
preconditions.description: Set S contains m strictly increasing integers between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (stdout.split() and (n := int(stdout.split()[0])) <= 4000 and all(1 <= a <= 10**6 for a in (a := list(map(int, stdout.split()[1:])))) and len(a) == n)
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is a valid sequence of length n ≤ 4000 with each element between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and (S_derived := {gcd(*a[i:j+1]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n)}) == S
postconditions.description: The derived set of all possible GCDs of contiguous subsequences of the output sequence matches the input set S.
